questions.question: Which aggregator API should the skill use?

options.label: Adzuna (Recommended)
options.description: Direct API, free tier ~250 calls/day, simple app_id+app_key auth, good global coverage incl. US/UK. Best signal-to-noise for a personal job search.

options.label: JSearch (via RapidAPI)
options.description: Better LinkedIn-job coverage specifically, but only ~150 calls/month on free tier and goes through RapidAPI middleman.

options.label: Wire both, let me pick per search
options.description: More code, more keys to manage, but flexible. Probably overkill for v1.

questions.question: Do you already have API credentials, or want me to walk you through signup?

options.label: I'll sign up now, walk me through it
options.description: I'll point you at the signup page and tell you exactly which fields to copy. Takes ~2 min for Adzuna.

options.label: I already have keys
options.description: You'll paste them and I'll wire them into a .env (gitignored).

options.label: Build the skill first, I'll add keys later
options.description: Skill is fully scaffolded with placeholder env vars; you drop credentials in when ready.

transcript_tail.text: Is there a LinkedIn or plugin for Claude code, uh, or MCP, uh, and or SKU or something? And, um, if not, uh, can we build a quick integration with LinkedIn so that I can… we can do some job searches? I’ll… we’ll narrow down what I’m looking for and, you know, help me look for it. Um,

Short answer: there's no official LinkedIn MCP from Anthropic, but a few community LinkedIn MCP servers exist on GitHub (mostly unofficial scrapers/wrappers around `linkedin-api` or Playwright). LinkedIn's official Jobs API is gated and not granted for personal use, so any "quick" integration realistically means either (a) a third-party job-board API like JSearch/Adzuna/Indeed that aggregates LinkedIn-style postings, or (b) a browser-automation MCP that drives LinkedIn while you're logged in — which works but technically violates LinkedIn's ToS and risks account flags.
